failures.pattern: [38;2;74;222;128m[1m✓[0m reveal shows 1/3 pass count on failure
failures.root_cause: sw-e2e-integration-test fails on GitHub issue creation (likely missing/invalid GitHub auth or API access in CI), cascading to skip the pipeline test; sw-intent-analysis-test fails because analyze_intent's generated JSON is missing required schema fields (version, goal, criteria)
failures.fix: Ensure GitHub credentials/token are configured for e2e integration test environment, and update the intent-analysis schema generator to include version, goal, and criteria fields

failures.root_cause: sw-e2e-integration-test suite exited non-zero during real Claude/GitHub integration checks
failures.fix: inspect sw-e2e-integration-test.sh output/logs for the failing assertion and fix the underlying API or auth handling

failures.root_cause: sw-cost-test.sh asserts CONTEXT EFFICIENCY dashboard renders event data, but no cost entries exist in the last 30 days so it falls back to the empty-state message
failures.fix: seed a costs.json entry with a loop.context_efficiency event in the test fixture before invoking the dashboard, or widen the lookback window used by the test

failures.root_cause: Memory promotion cross-repo copy test uses config_get, which reads the real repo's policy.json instead of the test's isolated config
failures.fix: Have the promotion code/test use policy_get or an injectable config path so the test can redirect to its temp fixture
